plans.idea: Classic banner sweep left to right: logo as a quiet brand anchor at the far left, then the bottle and the 'Glow' headline locked together as one product-and-name unit, and the Shop Now button closing at the far right, so the four gaps are even instead of leaving the headline floating in the middle.
Brand block on the left (logo stacked over a large 'Glow' headline, sharing one left edge), the bottle as the centred focal point, and the CTA on the right: a three-part symmetrical composition.

Product-led message cluster: the bottle opens the strip, followed straight away by the 'Glow' headline and the Shop Now button as one tight left-to-centre story, with the logo signing off at the far right.
